events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 years since his death
events.blurb: On September 7, 1996, Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, dying six days later on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, we lost a true icon. Tupac Shakur's music continues to resonate, tackling social injustice and inspiring generations. What's your favourite track from the legendary artist?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix: 56 years since his passing
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix died in London on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27, with the official cause of death being asphyxiation due to inhalation of vomit after taking barbiturates.

angles.name: Hendrix's Influence
angles.copy: 56 years ago, the world lost a guitar legend. Jimi Hendrix redefined what was possible with six strings. Which of his tracks still gives you chills?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From 'Come Together' to 'Here Comes the Sun', it's an album ingrained in music history. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Christine Ellen Hynde was born on September 7, 1951, and is an American-British singer, songwriter, and musician, best known as a founding member and lead vocalist of The Pretenders.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman still rocks harder than most. What's your favourite Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: William John Paul Gallagher was born on September 21, 1972, and is an English singer and songwriter, famous as the lead singer and co-founder of Oasis.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the iconic Liam Gallagher. What's your top Oasis track or solo hit?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' single: 55 years
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the United States on October 11, 1971, from his album of the same name.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace and unity that still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The first iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how people listened to music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago, Apple changed the game for music lovers. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the release date of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Time to celebrate 007's enduring legacy. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Winston Lennon was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool, England, and would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Marwood Cleese was born on October 27, 1939, and is an English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer, known for his work with Monty Python and Fawlty Towers.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered the iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that showcased their incredible range. Which track stands out most for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury: 35 years since his death
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, died on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie's Enduring Voice
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a legend. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song to blast out loud?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles' groundbreaking album that marked a significant evolution in their sound. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon: 46 years since his death
events.blurb: John Lennon was fatally shot on December 8, 1980, outside his New York City residence at the age of 40.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world fell silent as we lost John Lennon. His legacy of peace, love, and revolutionary music lives on. What's the one song of his that moves you most?
